name: app-result-impact-slide-with-blue-spray-arc-and-stat-cards
title: Result and Impact with Blue Spray Arc
whatItIs: A pale slide with a numbered Result & Impact pill, a large headline fading from black to grey, a grainy blue spray-painted arc sweeping down the right and three white stat cards with percentages, a tick slider and a half gauge.
whatItMeans: The airbrushed arc adds a human, energetic gesture to clean data, and each stat card has its own small graphic.
techniques: Grainy spray arc as a decorative sweep behind cards
Headline that fades line by line
Blue highlight on key phrases inside cards
Different mini graphics per stat (slider, gauge)

vocabulary.definition: A soft grainy curved stroke that looks airbrushed.
A ruler-like scale with one marked value.
A card built around one figure and caption.
